title: One surface path and one edge loop: SurfaceSpline, SurfaceRing, PlaneSurfaceLoop and RingCandidates compose TracedSurfacePath instead of copying its fields
description:
Repo plan merge 3C.16. TracedSurfacePath (positions, surfacePositions, vertexId, edgeId, faceId, fraction, closed) is the core path; SurfaceSpline (17-102) copies the same arrays and converts both ways (followPath :329, surfacePath :415) between double and float; SurfaceRing and SurfaceSpline both repeat polyline, markedByEdgeId, markedEdgeIds, markedEdgeCount, unresolvedGaps, length, meanRadius, centroid; RingCandidates (39-87) is the same as struct-of-arrays; PlaneSurfaceLoop (28-37) is a subset. Choose float or double once; the ring and spline types hold a TracedSurfacePath plus an edge-loop value (mask, ids, count, gaps) and its measures. Data classes stop running algorithms (SurfaceRing.through/tightenedOrNull :83,107, PlaneSurfaceLoop.walk :69, RingCandidates statics :144,175 move to their tracer/builder). RingTool reads these fields directly, so this lands after the tool merge.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. No path or ring type duplicates TracedSurfacePath's arrays; no float/double round trip.
2. Ring and bisector fingerprints on the crawfish and fertility DSL copies byte-identical; saved DSLs reload identically.
3. Unit suite passes; launch entry and screenshot of the ring scene.
testing-plan:
1. Fingerprints before and after.
2. mvn test; BisectorTest, ring tests.
